ai.title: AI integration
ai.lead: The methods BETTER deploys and the third-party frontier architectures it benchmarks.

entries.text: A DeepONet and KAN thermal surrogate model rapidly predicts chamber and wafer heat distribution.
entries.metric: Benchmark metric: MAPE 0.035%, training 62× faster, memory 31× lower (metric from the original domain)

entries.text: An encoder-decoder CNN predicts temperature contours and electrothermal coupling effects.
entries.metric: Benchmark metric: average IR error 0.053 mV (metric from the original domain)

entries.text: A virtual counterpart of the deposition chamber simulates gas flow, temperature and thickness uniformity.
entries.metric: Benchmark metric: virtual validation shortens process condition setup
